fusions.name: Unbuckling Vault
fusions.desc: Vaults you up to 5.5 tiles onto the target and works loose the straps of every enemy within 3 tiles: each takes 11 damage and loses 20% armour and 15% movement speed for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flicked Rivets
fusions.desc: Flicks a rivet pried from your plate that deals 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Snatch and Return
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be caught and sent back to whoever laid it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Ducking Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
